title: Use a prefix
instructions: Use the word parts and the sentence together, then choose the best answer.

parts.prompt: The new rule was unpopular: very few students liked it. What does “un-” add to “popular”?

choice_rationales.A: Few students liked it, so it was not popular.
choice_rationales.B: The rule was not popular a second time.
choice_rationales.C: Time order is not the point.
choice_rationales.D: The sentence shows a lack of support, not too much of something.

parts.hint: Read the words after the colon.
parts.correct_explanation: Un- often means not, and few students liked the rule.
